The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — The reported fixed Parik24 promotional banner could not be reproduced:⁠ the reported page loads fine in the reporter's own filter profile (both Ukrainian and Russian locales) and in an unfiltered control, and full-page vision plus DOM inspection find no fixed/promo overlay or any banner-like element, only an already-blocked ad rotator producing empty zones. Recommend closing without a rule.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

The run instruction states no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, not another anti-adblock wall, and not a scam/phishing report, so rule generation was open (allow_rule_generation). No rule of the repository policy as stated in the run instruction blocks the fix; the close recommendation rests on reproduction evidence, not on a policy gate.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On note.com the reported "広告" is a shopping/affiliate product card (Amazon Japan, with Sponsored-Products link parameters) rendered inside the article body by note.com's own external-article embed widget; no filter rule covered it, so a cosmetic rule hiding the figure that carries `.external-article-widget--type_shopping` was written. It validated in the AdGuard CLI proxy:⁠ the card is hidden after the rule, page integrity is intact, with no residue and no remaining instances. ## Rule `note.com##figure[name][id]:has(.external-article-widget--type_shopping)` ## Policy rationale The run instruction closes only site-owned advertising, paywalls and anti-adblock walls; this element is a third-party Amazon affiliate/shopping embed with sponsored-ad link parameters inside the article, not the site's ad inventory, and it is not a paywall or an anti-adblock wall. The repository already blocks note.com article affiliate figures (note.com,note.jp#⁠#⁠figure[⁠name]⁠[⁠id]⁠ ⁠> a[⁠href^="https:⁠//px.a8.net/svt/ejp"]⁠ ⁠> img[⁠width="300"]⁠[⁠height="250"]⁠ in JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt), so this class of note.com affiliate embed is treated as blockable. ## Place in the list [JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/6a80bb0e6c5d777370140a6f305e5c8e06425bf4/JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 1388](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/6a80bb0e6c5d777370140a6f305e5c8e06425bf4/JapaneseFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1388). ## Screenshots

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — With the reporter's exact 13-filter selection loaded in the prepared extension, r4.rudub.world/browse.php loads fully intact — readable Cyrillic nav (Новинки, Сериалы, Дубляж, Регистрация, Вход), the "В эфире:⁠ Укрытие. 3 сезон" hero artwork, all first-party CSS/fonts/images at 200 and no hidden or empty content — so the garbled text and missing hero of the reporter's screenshot do not reproduce. Only trackers (gtag, Yandex Metrika, Yadro counter) are blocked, by existing Tracking Protection rules, so no rule change is needed.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's filter policy lists no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is not first-party advertising, not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, not an anti-adblock wall at all, and not a scam/phishing page, so rule generation is open and the report is judged on reproduction evidence. The agent never closes an issue; this outcome only recommends closing because the reported defect is absent on the loaded reported page with the reporter's own filter selection.

### Issue URL (Anti Adblock Script) [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/faa-ground-stop-canceled-flights-travelers-what-we-know/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cbsnews.com%2Fnews%2Ffaa-ground-stop-canceled-flights-travelers-what-we-know%2F) ### Comment > ### Issue Description > Anti-adblock wall on `cbsnews.com` via Admiral First-Party Proxy. > > * **A/B Test Behavior:** Clean/Incognito sessions are served an inescapable hard wall with no dismiss link and page scrolling locked (`overflow: hidden`). Some regular sessions occasionally receive a variant with a delayed *"I'll fix it next time"* dismiss button. > * **Consent Requirement:** Only triggers after OneTrust (`cbsoptanon`) allows targeting/advertising cookies (`cmp.ot.targetingAllowed`). > > ### Proxied Admiral Script URLs Observed > * `https://silkyslumber.com/static/kmxtcpfvq/q1zxupa.js` > * `https://topicspin.com/static/k6vi91qgp/siqqoqasp4mu874ckh6569s5n2uum.js` > > ### Inline Bootstrap & Obfuscation Details > * Admiral's inline loader is wrapped in `loadAdmiralScript()` and invoked asynchronously inside `cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady` $\rightarrow$ `cmp.ot.targetingAllowed`. > * Because `loadAdmiralScript()` runs asynchronously after `document.currentScript` is `null`, inline scriptlets hooking `document.createElement` do not catch it. > * Evades generic Admiral signatures by aliasing `decodeURI` (`D(D(Y))`) and double-encoding `'admiral'` (`%25%36%31%64m%25%36%39%25%37%32%2561%6C`). > * Static Admiral Property ID in inline script: `QS01RDlDQzI1QTgyQ0FFMzUwNTQ5RkMwQUMtMg` > > ### Suggested / Verified Fix > Aborting synchronously when `loadAdmiralScript` is registered with `cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady` blocks Admiral before any proxied scripts are fetched: > ```adblock > cbsnews.com#%#//scriptlet('abort-current-inline-script', 'cbsoptanon.onScriptsReady', 'loadAdmiralScript') > ``` ``` Username: @SpoiledSneeze ``` ### Screenshots

issue.title: Counterfeit Luhxe storefront: luhxetravelbag.co

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Issue
`luhxetravelbag.co` is a live counterfeit storefront impersonating Luhxe and selling the copied "Luhxe Travel Bag 2.0" at Luhxe's exact $129/$179 price points.

### Evidence
- Official brand: https://luhxe.com
- Infringing pages: https://luhxetravelbag.co/ and https://luhxetravelbag.co/buy-now/
- LUHXE is USPTO registration 7,656,203, owned by The PocketPharma Store LLC.
- Fresh comparison against 585 current Luhxe image hashes found numerous exact copies retaining Luhxe's original Shopify filenames and UUIDs, including ProductImage12_1.jpg, ProductImage5.jpg and five GemPages assets.
- Registrar is Spaceship; Cloudflare DNS/reverse proxy; Shopify checkout infrastructure is linked from the buy-now flow.
- Authorized registrar, CDN and platform notices were delivered on 5 Nov 2026.

### Request
Please evaluate this domain for AdGuard's malicious/counterfeit-shop filters to warn users before they transact. This is brand impersonation and a fake shop, not merely a trademark dispute over a parked name.

comment.body: Thanks! I've added `luhxetravelbag.co` as scam domain. It's take some time to applying in AdGuard DNS.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — kangol.com opens a Klaviyo "Enter your email to unlock 15% OFF" modal that dims and locks the product page, and the published Annoyances/Popups lists do not cover it. Adding kangol.com to the existing shared Klaviyo onsite-script rule (`||static.klaviyo.com/onsite/js/*/klaviyo.js$domain=…`) stops the loader; the A/B/C experiment blocked the script and the popup, dimmer and scroll lock never appeared, verified by the bound visual review. ## Rule `||static.klaviyo.com/onsite/js/*/klaviyo.js$domain=kangol.com` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The reported symptom is a newsletter/promo subscription popup, the exact purpose of the AdGuard Popups filter ("Popups and forms for subscribing to news, promotions, and various events"), so it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall and not an anti-adblock wall — none of the run instruction's closing rules applies. The maintainer rule on shared rules applies:⁠ an existing multi-domain Klaviyo newsletter-popup family covers the same vendor and path pattern for other domains, and the reported domain is absent from it, so the fix is to add kangol.com to that family rather than write a new site-only rule. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/48bef83a66a920568708c15c7644b6bff026cdb4/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 7031](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/48bef83a66a920568708c15c7644b6bff026cdb4/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt#L7031). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44032516378 Automated analysis against filters at `48bef83`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reporter's target is the fixed first-party "Türkiye Dijital Abonelik" self-promotion band (`div#aboneBanner.tgb-wrap`, position:⁠fixed, top:⁠0, 160px tall, z-index 9999) that still covers the site header and the top of the article in the current filtered build, although the repository's old rule for it (`#$#.abone-banner`) no longer matches. Hiding it with `turkiyegazetesi.com.tr##div#aboneBanner` resolved the symptom in both experiments with no ad-layout residue and no remaining instances, but the bound vision review rejected it for page integrity on grounds that DOM measurements show are pre-existing page conditions (lazy images that are blank on the baseline too, and the site's own nav logo SVG misread as overlapping text), so the rule reaches a human unverified.

## Candidate for review

`turkiyegazetesi.com.tr##div#aboneBanner`

AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt

Not verified: Two apply_rule experiments in the locked reporter-profile baseline (div#⁠aboneBanner, then the broader .tgb-wrap) both showed adElementStatus visible-⁠>hidden, symptom resolved, adLayoutResidue absent and remainingInstances empty, with environmentExperiment 'inconclusive' and failedCandidateChecks empty, but the bound vision review set pageIntegrity 'regressed'. Its two damage items are not caused by the rule:⁠ the main nav's 12 links have zero geometric overlap and no 'TASARRUF' text exists in the DOM (the review misread the site's single 'Tasarruf Ortağım' logo SVG image in the nav), and the blank 'GÖZDEN KAÇMASIN' thumbnails are 21 lazy-loaded images with naturalWidth 0 that are already blank on the unfiltered baseline; a separate full-page vision pass over the same after-capture reported the header intact and no gap where the band was. Hiding a fixed out-of-flow container cannot shift in-flow content, so the candidate is carried as unverified rather than confirmed.

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"0e2cf3a170057c7111d607badb98b41169c2c951c039420daa0ebeafc0aa6a49"} -->
The filter policy leaves this report to a maintainer

## Reproduced symptom

Reproduced the reported anti-adblock countdown ("Ad blocker detected", 15 s delay) on apkcube.com's APK download page after tapping the download button, but the captured traffic shows no detector script — the gate is the site's own dialog with a fixed countdown and the download proceeds to its hold-to-verify step without disabling the ad blocker — so the run instruction's anti-adblock clause and the filter policy block a rule here and the report goes to a maintainer.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, anti-adblock clause:⁠ "Any other anti-adblock wall:⁠ write a rule only once the page's requests the agent captured show the detector script; without it, hand the report to a maintainer." The wall is not German (page is Japanese/English), so this clause governs. The captured requests of the reported page show no detector script:⁠ the only request the download tap adds is the first-party /api/apps/com.facebook.aura/download-token, and the gate itself is the site's own React dialog whose countdown component receives only {open, onOpenChange, seconds:⁠15, onDone} with no detection input. The first-party scripts that could hide such a detector (/ads/banner-ad.js, the obfuscated ad SDK served as /lhqihrtalh.js) both returned HTTP 200 while the gate still appeared. No rule may be written without that evidence, so the report belongs to a maintainer. Filter policy (filter-policy.md) also argues against a rule:⁠ detection messages are not blocked when they let the user proceed to the content or offer an alternative that carries no privacy/security risk. After the 15-second countdown the page's own "Verify to download / Hold to verify" dialog naming Muse-from-Meta_16.0.0.11.159_apkcube.apk appears, so the download completes without disabling the ad blocker; the premium upsell is a second non-risky alternative. Because the wall does overlay the whole viewport and its "ad blocker detected" claim is not backed by any detection the run could observe, the remaining judgement belongs to a maintainer rather than to an automated close.

## Artifacts

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — The reported broken post thumbnails on blog.naver.com do not reproduce:⁠ with the reporter's own imported filter selection and Stealth Mode the extension loads all post thumbnails (HTTP 200, zero broken images) and full-page vision finds none of the broken placeholders, exactly as in the unfiltered control; only Naver analytics scripts are blocked. No rule is needed, so the report is recommended for closing.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

No rule in the run instruction's filter policy blocks rule generation for this report:⁠ it is an incorrect-blocking claim on a page that shows no first-party-ad, paywall or anti-adblock element, and the instruction's policy list gives no closing rule that applies. The repository policy states that tracking-protection filters should not block a tracker when blocking would disrupt the site's correct functioning; the only requests blocked here are Naver analytics/logging scripts, nothing that feeds the post thumbnails. The recommendation to close rests on reproduction evidence, not on a policy rule:⁠ the reported broken thumbnails are absent with the reporter's own filter selection and also absent unfiltered, so no rule is needed.

### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;

### What product do you use?

AdGuard for Android

### AdGuard version

4.15.2

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

the problem is with app, not a site

### Which device do you use?

Mobile

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yazio.android

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Tracking Protection filter

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

Hi, I work on the YAZIO mobile apps.

The rule ||yazio-analytics.com^ from [AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters#221525](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/221525) also blocks fae.yazio-analytics.com. Our Android and iOS apps download their GrowthBook feature config from this host (/api/features/<client key>). It is a static JSON file, the same for every user, and the request sends no user data.

We use it for kill switches. If a new feature breaks, we turn it off remotely. With this rule, the app never gets the kill switch.

Could you add @@||fae.yazio-analytics.com^, or narrow the rule to the event-ingestion host?

I can send the full URL privately if you want to check it.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body: Hi @Alex-302, thanks for looking into this, and sorry for the late reply. Could you reopen it? Here’s the missing information. What the user sees: with AdGuard on, YAZIO can’t download its feature config, so it silently falls back to the defaults built into the installed version. New features and redesigns are rolled out through this config, so AdGuard users get them months later than everyone else, often only after a later app update. If a new feature turns out to be broken, we disable it remotely with a kill switch, but AdGuard users never receive it and keep the broken feature. Why this matters more than I first reported: I tested it again. The block comes from ||yazio-analytics.com^ in the AdGuard DNS filter, which is enabled by default, so it also affects free users who never turned on tracking protection (screenshots below). @@||fae.yazio-analytics.com^ in DNS user rules fixes it. On the domain name: you’re right that critical functionality shouldn’t live on an analytics-named domain, and we are in the process of moving the config to our main API domain. Existing app versions will keep requesting fae.yazio-analytics.com, though, and many users stay on older versions for a long time. The host only serves a static JSON file, the same for every user, with no user or device data in the request. We’re fine with event-ingestion.yazio-analytics.com staying blocked. Could you add @@||fae.yazio-analytics.com^? Thanks!

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"406fb6d878ba6a32cf22e543a09fceb580ae0a7aeec04cd9279422663961097e"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — www⁠.imore.com replaces its articles with an Ad-Shield anti-adblock wall from report.error-report.com/modal ("Cannot find html-load.com script"), reproduced with Base + Mobile Ads although BaseFilter already blocks html-load.com and injects its Ad-Shield scriptlets for imore.com. apply_rule failed with phase_proof_unavailable and the reported page state cannot be captured at all, so the site-scoped network rule blocking that vendor host is handed over unverified.

## Candidate for review

`||error-report.com^$domain=imore.com`

BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: No phase result and no capture of the reported page state. All four apply_rule calls (candidate retried, a narrower variant, a fresh CLI-route session) ended with environment_capability_limited / phase_proof_unavailable, then repeatedFailure, and the host refused to retry the filtering environment. Capturing the page is structurally impossible:⁠ the wall leaves document.body null and the document exactly viewport-sized (1920x1080 and 375x812), and every screenshot of it timed out (tileCoverage complete=false, tiles=[⁠]⁠), with and without a tileWindow, on the article and on www⁠.imore.com/. The only complete capture in the proxied session is of www⁠.imore.com/robots.txt, which says nothing about the symptom. Unproven whether removing the wall document restores the article, since the site already removed document.body when the wall fired.

## Missing information

- No way to obtain the required complete full-page capture of the reported page state: The finish_fix gate requires complete full-page vision captured in the CLI-proxied session for https:⁠//www⁠.imore.com/retro-review-2009-mac-pro-2018, but that page state cannot be captured in this environment. With the locked AdGuard Base + Mobile Ads baseline, the site's Ad-Shield fallback removes document.body and attaches a fixed full-viewport cross-origin iframe (report.error-report.com/modal), so the document is exactly viewport-sized (documentHeight == viewportHeight, desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 375x812). In three sessions every screenshot call failed identically:⁠ 'page.screenshot:⁠ Timeout 30000ms exceeded ... taking page screenshot ... fonts loaded', with tileCoverage.complete false, tiles [⁠]⁠ and error 'page.screenshot:⁠ Timeout 45000ms exceeded'; captureTiles with and without an explicit tileWindow failed the same way, on the article page and on https:⁠//www⁠.imore.com/ (all site pages are walled with this baseline). inspect_full_page_capture answers errorKind full_page_capture_incomplete and tells the agent not to recapture the same page state, but offers no alternative that yields the required vision. apply_rule is likewise unusable on this page:⁠ every call, including a retry, a second candidate and a fresh session, ended with environment_capability_limited / phase_proof_unavailable ('The controlled browser observation did not complete'), then repeatedFailure. Missing:⁠ a documented way to (a) capture this body-less, cross-origin-iframe page state, or (b) finish an analysis-only outcome when the reported page state is structurally uncapturable and the candidate experiment cannot run.

No filter rule is needed, so the report is recommended for closing as not reproduced.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

No rule of the run instruction's filter policy closes this report:⁠ it is an incorrect-blocking report, not first-party advertising, not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall and not an anti-adblock wall at all, and it is not a scam/phishing page. issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

AdGuard for Android

### AdGuard version

4.15.2

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

the problem is with app, not a site

### Which device do you use?

Mobile

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yazio.android

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Mobile Ads filter, AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Tracking Protection filter

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

Hi, I work on the YAZIO mobile apps.

The rule ||yazio-analytics.com^ from [AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters#221525](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/221525) also blocks fae.yazio-analytics.com. Our Android and iOS apps download their GrowthBook feature config from this host (/api/features/<client key>). It is a static JSON file, the same for every user, and the request sends no user data.

We use it for kill switches. If a new feature breaks, we turn it off remotely. With this rule, the app never gets the kill switch.

Could you add @@||fae.yazio-analytics.com^, or narrow the rule to the event-ingestion host?

I can send the full URL privately if you want to check it.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body:
> [@micheledezanet](https://github.com/micheledezanet) Which subdomain of yazio-analytics.com is used for analytics? I found few, but not sure about purposes.
> 
> auth.next.yazio-analytics.com dagster.next.yazio-analytics.com event-ingestion.next.yazio-analytics.com next.yazio-analytics.com

Thanks for checking. The YAZIO apps (Android and iOS) use only two subdomains:

- event-ingestion.yazio-analytics.com: analytics. The app sends usage events here. Blocking it is fine. The app works the same without it.
- fae.yazio-analytics.com: feature configuration (GrowthBook feature flags), not analytics. The app needs it to load its configuration. If it is blocked, users get a default config, and some features change or stop working. This is the domain that we ask you to unblock.

The apps do not use the next.* subdomains (auth.next, dagster.next, event-ingestion.next, next). They are internal to our data platform, and the apps do not contact them.

So the suggested change is to replace ||yazio-analytics.com^ with ||event-ingestion.yazio-analytics.com^, or to add an exception for fae.yazio-analytics.com.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — vpslayer.net shows a first-party "Cookies" consent banner (`.cookie-consent`, a fixed full-width overlay) that no existing filter handles. Hiding it with `vpslayer.net##.cookie-consent` was verified in the reporter's own settings profile (banner gone, page intact), so the fix is to add this domain to the existing shared `##.cookie-consent` expression in the Cookie Notices filter. ## Rule `vpslayer.net##.cookie-consent` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The run instruction's filter policy closes only first-party advertising, paywalls and German anti-adblock walls; this report is a cookie-consent notice (T:⁠ Annoyance, N:⁠ AdGuard Browser Extension), which is exactly what the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter exists to handle. Not an anti-adblock wall:⁠ the banner is a consent dialog, not an ad-blocker detector, and no anti-adblock measure was observed (baseline phases report antiAdblockDetected false). Filter policy (Annoyance filters / AdGuard Cookie Notices filter) states that simply hiding the corresponding element is sufficient in most cases; the verified rule does that and leaves the page functional. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/8db6e2559e7b71806bb23265956241319c7a3f28/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 76](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/8db6e2559e7b71806bb23265956241319c7a3f28/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L76). ## Screenshots

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"a1ff0fa786e3a86b0f899068dda025533aa6087d8bcc3e907dd54f7dbcaa4b14"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The AdGuard Cookie Notices rule `/cookie-consent.` blocks https:⁠//picpay.com/scripts/cookie-consent.js, the script that adds `body.appear`, and since global.css keeps `body{display:none}` until then the whole picpay.com/pt-br/pj page renders blank, exactly as reported. The fix is to add picpay.com to the existing exception `@@/cookie-consent.$domain=cunardcruceros.com` in AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_allowlist.txt; A/B phases showed the page fully restored with no ads, but the vision review stayed inconclusive and then rejected the run only for blank news-card thumbnails that the unfiltered control shows populated, so the rule is carried unverified.

## Candidate for review

`@@/cookie-consent.$domain=cunardcruceros.com|picpay.com`

AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_allowlist.txt

Not verified: Never confirmed clean. Phase B reproduced the defect (blank page, documentHeight 1080, main 0x0); phase C restored the page (documentHeight 13062, main 1920x9114, header/hero/CTA present, 10 of 12 media visible, no ads, adLayoutResidue absent). Runs 1-2 returned visualReview 'inconclusive' because the restored 'AVISO DE PRIVACIDADE' dialog overlapped the symptom region; run 3, which added a reveal click on 'Aceitar todos os cookies', returned 'rejected' for three blank thumbnails in 'Ver todas as notícias'. That is not attributable to the rule:⁠ the same run's unfiltered phase A, with the same click, shows those thumbnails populated, and an allowlist exception only unblocks a request. environmentExperiment stayed 'inconclusive', failedCandidateChecks empty; the 3 allowed candidate runs are exhausted.

## Still visible after the rule

- Ver todas as notícias — card 'Prepare sua loja para a Black Friday com o PicPay' — The news card shows a large blank white thumbnail area above the article title; no image, placeholder, or alternative content is rendered.
- Ver todas as notícias — card 'Como conectar contas PJ de outros bancos pelo Open Finance' — The news card shows a large blank white thumbnail area above the article title; no image, placeholder, or alternative content is rendered.
- Ver todas as notícias — card 'Transferência de limite:⁠ use crédito no negócio' — The news card shows a large blank white thumbnail area above the article title; no image, placeholder, or alternative content is rendered.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — elster-online-finanzamt.chemionix.com, reached from citivillage.net/redirect, served an ELSTER lookalike German tax-portal form (homoglyph title, "Persönliche Daten" asking for tax ID and date of birth) inside a full-screen iframe; the repository's policy sends phishing reports to an ordinary blocking rule, so I propose ||elster-online-finanzamt.chemionix.com^$document for the German filter. It reaches a human unverified:⁠ with the candidate applied the experiment's phase C never loaded the page (net:⁠:⁠ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT), and on the verified page the site's own cache endpoint 302-loops into an error frame, so no rendered-phase judgement was possible.

## Candidate for review

`||elster-online-finanzamt.chemionix.com^$document`

GermanFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: apply_rule returned environmentExperiment 'inconclusive' with validationSkipped true and no visual review:⁠ with the candidate applied, phase C could not load the page — 'Phase C navigation failed (navigation_timeout):⁠ ... page.goto:⁠ net:⁠:⁠ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT at https:⁠//elster-online-finanzamt.chemionix.com/eportal/efcd6242-...'. An identical retry reproduced it and the host directed an analysis-only finish. Verified-navigation current-extension sessions also cannot render the page:⁠ its full-viewport iframe ends on chrome-error:⁠//chromewebdata/ after a 302 chain on the site's /eportal//cache/<⁠id⁠> endpoint (72 x 302 in artifact:⁠har:⁠72b08ea6; a direct open failed with net:⁠:⁠ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS), so those full-page captures are blank frames (error_or_blank, symptom indeterminate). The lookalike form is only observable on the citivillage.net/redirect entry, which the host does not count as the reported page.

The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

The reported web.de URL is a dedicated German adblock-wall page ("Aufgrund deines Adblockers zeigen wir WEB.DE nicht an.", with a button to switch the ad blocker off and a paid ad-free mailbox alternative). The run instruction's policy says German anti-adblock walls get no rule, so this report is recommended for closing.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction policy, verbatim:⁠ "German anti-adblock walls:⁠ no rule; recommend closing. This covers only a German site's wall or popup that detects the ad blocker and asks to disable it or to allowlist the site." The page itself - not the reporter's problem-type label - shows the German wall:⁠ issues screenshot 1 and the live capture of the reported URL both show web.de's Fairplay adblock gate with "Aufgrund deines Adblockers zeigen wir WEB.DE nicht an." / "Dein Adblocker ist aktiviert" and the button "Adblocker ausschalten und weiter ins Postfach" (German-language site). No candidate rule was written:⁠ the policy closes this class of report before rule generation, so there is nothing to validate with apply_rule.

## Artifacts

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — With the reporter's own settings profile reproduced (filters 1, 2, 18–22, stealth off, import URL applied), pikabu.ru loads HTTP 200 and renders its full header, feed and 14 posts; the reported empty white page does not occur, on first load or after a reload, and no applied rule hides the page. Recommend closing as not reproduced while noting the verification ran in the Chromium MV3 extension, not the reporter's Firefox MV2 build with uBlock Origin alongside.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's filter policy lists no rule that closes an incorrect-blocking report:⁠ first-party ads, paywalls and German anti-adblock walls are the policy closures, and none applies here. No other policy rule blocks a fix for pikabu.ru, so rule generation was permitted; the report is recommended for closing on the observed evidence instead.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"788acd58600854d5f5a35ff2cd200e2cbee30e2b17b29d514d669cc751d03a3d"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — scanwp.net serves a hidden "BEFORE YOU GO" Cloudways discount modal that its own script /js/exit-popup.js opens on exit intent; the lists only still block the popup's obsolete Bloom ids (#⁠bio_ep), so it shows again. The candidate `||scanwp.net/js/exit-popup.js` stops the loader in one rule, but it could not be visually validated because the automation cannot perform the top-edge pointer exit that reveals the popup.

## Candidate for review

`||scanwp.net/js/exit-popup.js`

AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/popups_specific.txt

Not verified: The popup only opens on exit intent (document mouseout with relatedTarget null and clientY <⁠= 0, armed 5 s after load), which the browser tools cannot perform, so the popup was invisible in every phase:⁠ apply_rule returned environmentExperiment inconclusive, validationSkipped true, errorKind baseline_symptom_absent (phases A and B), and no visual review judged the rule. The causal loader, the matching popup markup (identical to reporter screenshot 2) and the absence of any covering rule were proven from the HAR, DOM and script source; only the visual confirmation is missing. Blocking the loader also stops the body.exit-popup-open scroll lock and the swp_exit_popup_seen storage writes, which an element-hiding rule could not do in one rule.

## Artifacts

comment.body:
Hi @Alex-302, thanks a lot for looking into this and for identifying the exact domains.

We confirm that all four are our legitimate production domains: cashea.app, www.cashea.app, mobile.api.cashea.app and core.api.cashea.app. None of them hosts phishing or malware.

Status update (Nov 17, morning, UTC-3): our team is still able to reproduce the problem. With AdGuard DNS Browsing Security enabled the Cashea app fails to connect, and it works again as soon as AdGuard DNS is disabled. So the block is still active and users are still affected.

Since this comes from Browsing Security and not from the DNS filter, could you help us with either of these? Allowlist/unblock the four domains above in Browsing Security, or escalate this to whoever maintains it.

If there is a better channel for Browsing Security false positives (for example the AdGuard DNS support email), please let us know and we will follow up there too.

Thanks again!

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On krowki.waw.pl a fixed cookie-consent toast ("Nasza strona używa plików cookies", "Tak, akceptuję") permanently overlays the "Polecane produkty" carousel and no official filter hides it. Adding the domain-scoped element-hiding rule krowki.waw.pl#⁠#⁠.toast-cookies was verified in the reporter's profile:⁠ the toast is gone, no layout residue, page integrity intact. ## Rule `krowki.waw.pl##.toast-cookies` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is an annoyance cookie-consent notice, not the site's own advertising (first-party ads), so no closing rule applies. It is not a paywall:⁠ the storefront content is fully readable behind the toast. It is not an anti-adblock wall of any kind, so neither the German anti-adblock closing rule nor the anti-adblock detector-script requirement applies. The filter policy's traffic criterion is not a stated closing rule; with no traffic data available it is left to the maintainer (recorded via report_missing_information). ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/6a6f797931663d2882fd8a83fccfe5371a1203b2/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Missing information - No traffic statistics available to apply the filter-policy traffic criterion: The linked filter policy requires that site-specific rules only be added when traffic is sufficient (\~100,000 visits/month), decided by public statistics or indirect indicators, with the final decision left to filter developers. The run offers no tool or data source for krowki.waw.pl's traffic, so the agent cannot evaluate this criterion and leaves it to the maintainer. The proposed rule is otherwise fully validated in the browser. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — houseofpostcards.pl shows an undismissed Shoper cookie-consent panel plus its full-viewport dimming mask, and neither the reporter's Cookie Notices filter nor any current list hides them. The domain-scoped element-hiding rule `houseofpostcards.pl##.consents__wrapper, .consents__mask` was verified in the reporter's extension profile:⁠ panel and mask gone, page integrity intact, no remaining instances. ## Rule `houseofpostcards.pl##.consents__wrapper, .consents__mask` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is an annoyance (cookie notice), which is not one of the run instruction's close categories:⁠ it is not first-party advertising, not a paywall, and not a German anti-adblock wall (the page shows only a consent notice; no ad-block detection or 'disable your blocker' message appears in the screenshot or the DOM). The Cookie Notices filter exists to hide cookie notices and the maintainer rule accepts hiding the notice when the page then works — verified here (content visible, no scroll lock, popup does not return). Controlled comparison note:⁠ the reporter profile could not be compared against defaults_plus_required because the first apply_rule experiment locked the validation baseline; the reporter profile reproduced the symptom and no current list rule covered it (get_applied_rules showed no consent rule). ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/17c3fb6d26ba8ead09927e63a544b89c0347a2cd/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44123536860 Automated analysis against filters at `17c3fb6`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

### Issue URL (Anti Adblock Script) [https://e.mail.ru/messages/inbox/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fe.mail.ru%2Fmessages%2Finbox%2F) ### Comment > При новом входе mail.ru блокирует доступ к некоторым ресурсам mail.ru. Если в браузере выключить расширение и выполнить первый вход на проблемный ресурс, то все последующие входы пройдут успешно с включённым блокировщиком. Если отключить фильтрацию на этой странице, то mail.ru всё равно будет блокировать доступ. Я предполагаю, что проблема в каком-то кэшируемом домене, так как все последующие входы с блокировщиком проходят без проблем. Сама проблема очень напряжённая, так как это касается не одного ресурса в mail.ru и это требует полного отключения расширения. ``` Username: @okSashaok ``` ### Screenshots

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — www⁠.foxnews.com still shows Admiral's "Please consider disabling your ad blocker" wall over the front page under the reporter's own filter set, and blocking the Admiral script host did not remove it. Hiding the wall's markup with a content-anchored cosmetic rule resolved the symptom and left the page intact in two validation runs, but the experiment stayed inconclusive because the very tall front page could not be fully inspected, so the rule is handed over unverified.

## Candidate for review

`foxnews.com##body > div:has(img[src^="https://%73%74%61tic.foxnew%73.com"])`

AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/antiadblock.txt

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — ministerstwo.pl's own full-screen cookie-consent dialog still appears under the reporter's filter set because no list covers it. The domain-scoped rule ministerstwo.pl#⁠#⁠.mdmconsent-backdrop verified in the reporter-profile baseline session with complete full-page vision:⁠ dialog gone, no remaining instances, page integrity intact. ## Rule `ministerstwo.pl##.mdmconsent-backdrop` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-consent annoyance, not first-party advertising, a paywall, or an anti-adblock wall, so none of the run instruction's close rules applies. The overlay is served by the site's own theme/module assets with no third-party detector or CMP host in the captured requests, so a normal cookie-notice hiding rule is the fix. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/0c5e3d67367ad2d83726da07a5a010021ce81ed1/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44121149032 Automated analysis against filters at `0c5e3d6`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

Fallback — The page refused to load in the run browser:⁠ main document returned HTTP 403

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Issue #⁠247453 reports that clicking anywhere on x1337x.eu opens a new tab with the popunder ad https:⁠//go.greentrafa.com/smartpop/... (the reporter's screenshot shows it already blocked by AdGuard Base filter). The 1337x mirror family already carries `1337x.*,1337x.pro#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open', '!1337x.')` in BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt, but the wildcard `1337x.*` does not cover the `x1337x.eu` label, so the click-hijack stays unmitigated there; the fix is to add x1337x.eu to that rule. No validation was possible:⁠ all three navigation attempts to the reported URL returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare interstitial ("Just a moment...") and the run's browser access to the target is exhausted, so the candidate goes to a human unverified.

## Candidate for review

`x1337x.eu,1337x.*,1337x.pro#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open', '!1337x.')`

BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: No apply_rule experiment could run:⁠ every navigation to https:⁠//x1337x.eu/search/season/1/ returned HTTP 403 with the Cloudflare interstitial 'Just a moment...' in three separate sessions (extension=none control, and two reported_on_current reporter sessions), and the run's browser access to the target then returned technical_attempt_budget_exhausted with the instruction not to launch another profile. Without a loaded page there was no baseline or filtered phase, no click rehearsal (the proof the targeting section requires for a click-opened ad tab) and no network log, so the extend_domains of the existing `1337x.*,1337x.pro#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open', '!1337x.')` rule stays browser-unverified; the root cause of the 403 is unknown and is not attributed to any site-side mechanism.

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"d64f7a23a81d18528d259f6bc2072925d09dca63dbb643c3081d396fd21933a6"} -->
The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

The reporter-defined defect is CloudFam's own paid "Skip the 60s queue" Monthly Pass modal, with a close X and an "I'll wait out the 60s queue" free path and no ad-blocker mention; the live reporter-profile session walks the reported URL through the queue to a working download page, where the site's detector only posts a skip_earning call and shows no wall. Paywalls and content-access offers get no rule under the run instruction's filter policy, so this should be closed rather than filtered.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

Run instruction filter policy, verbatim:⁠ 'Paywalls:⁠ no rule; recommend closing.' The reporter-defined defect is exactly a paid-access offer:⁠ the modal sells a '30-DAY MONTHLY PASS' ($14.99 / 30 days) that skips the site's 60-second ad-supported queue, i.e. a content-access measure paid for by the user. Run instruction filter policy, verbatim:⁠ 'Any other anti-adblock wall:⁠ write a rule only once the page's requests the agent captured show the detector script; without it, hand the report to a maintainer.' The live session shows the site's detector does not gate anything:⁠ /api/verify_access_code.php?action=skip_earning returns 200 and the page continues, so there is no anti-adblock wall to neutralize. AdGuard filter policy (https:⁠//github.com/AdguardTeam/KnowledgeBase/blob/master/docs/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy.md), 'Ad blocking filters - Limitations and exceptions', verbatim:⁠ 'Content access measures like paywalls are not blocked by Ad blocking filters.' and 'We do not block ad blocker detection messages that satisfy at least one of the following criteria:⁠ ... They allow the user to proceed to the website's content'. The reported modal names no ad blocker and offers both a close X and 'I'll wait out the 60s queue', so it is the site's own paid-self-promotion with a free path, not an aggressive anti-adblock wall.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The epihq.com homepage shows a first-party "Epi &⁠ Cookies" consent card fixed at the bottom-right that the reporter's AdGuard Cookie Notices filter does not hide. A domain-scoped element-hiding rule for its stable class was verified in the browser-extension baseline:⁠ the card is hidden, the page keeps its content and layout, and no residue remains. ## Rule `epihq.com##.WebCookieConsent` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall:⁠ the page's own requests contain no detector script and the page shows no anti-adblock message — only a consent card. The reported symptom is a first-party cookie notice left unhidden by the enabled AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, which is exactly the class of annoyance that filter exists to handle; a proven element-hiding rule for the site's stable consent class is the standard fix. The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The annotated annoyance on eletech.ru is the third-party Jivo chat widget, and the AdGuard Widgets rule `||jivosite.com^$third-party,domain=~jivosite.ru|~jivo.chat` already blocks its loader on this page. Full-page vision of the loaded page found no chat popup or widget, and nothing appeared during a five-minute dwell, so the reported defect did not reproduce and no new rule is needed.

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's closing rules cover first-party advertising, paywalls and German anti-adblock walls; none applies here (the target is a third-party Jivo chat widget, not the site's own advertising, a paywall or an anti-adblock wall), so rule generation remains allowed. The recommendation to close rests on the observed absence of the reported popup on the successfully loaded reported page (structured full-page vision returned reporterSymptomPresence "absent" and no chat window appeared during a five-minute dwell), not on a policy prohibition.

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The filtered baseline loads the PropertyGuru loan-calculator page intact (200, all first-party calculator scripts 200, form and button present, full-page vision shows no obstruction or ad gap) and Tracking Protection only blocks third-party trackers plus generic scriptlets, yet the reported defect — pressing "Calculate Monthly Mortgage" yields no result — could not be rehearsed because interact_page refuses clicks on that form's submit button, so no culprit rule or verifiable exception could be established.

## Missing information

- No documented way to exercise a form-submit control (e.g. a calculator button) in an incorrect-blocking run: The reported symptom of issue #⁠247468 is defined entirely by pressing the "Calculate Monthly Mortgage" button, which is a type=submit control inside <⁠form id="mortgage-calculator"⁠>. interact_page refused that click twice (targeting by textHint and by CSS selector, both targetFound=true) with refusalReason "publication", and no other tool may dispatch page events. Typing into the loan/interest/tenure inputs works, but the repayment summary only renders on submit and the type step's synthetic_number (12345) is below the form's RM 50,000 minimum, so a valid calculation cannot be provoked. Neither the run instruction nor the linked guidance documents say how to reproduce a form-submit interaction, so on BAIL the breakage could be neither shown in the baseline nor proven restored by a candidate.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — www⁠.plitch.com/pl shows its own MudBlazor cookie-consent modal ("Szanujemy Twoją prywatność") with a full-page dim layer on the filtered baseline, and the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter has no rule for the site. A domain-scoped element-hiding rule for the overlay was validated:⁠ modal hidden, page intact, no layout residue. ## Rule `plitch.com##.cookiebar-overlay` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-consent modal, which the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter exists to block; the filter policy explicitly expects such rules ('In most cases, simply hiding or blocking the corresponding scripts is sufficient'). Not the site's own advertising:⁠ no ad or sponsored creative is involved. Not a paywall and not a German anti-adblock wall:⁠ the page in Polish shows a consent dialog, with no ad-blocker detection in the captured requests or page state. No policy rule of the run instruction closes this report, so rule generation is open and the fix ships as a normal rule proposal. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/5dbf4704f00407300bdda383957953f518f31098/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/44173185133 Automated analysis against filters at `5dbf470`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

comment.body:
There are 2 scripts running which do this, on every `[click event]`.
JS 1 = opens "go.greentrafsa.com"
JS 2 = opens the current page "x1337x.eu" in a New Tab as a sort of Refresh

As a temporary workaround until the AdGuard team figure out how to block these scripts from running... 
adding these `[User Rules]` fixes the issue:
```
x1337x.eu#%#//scriptlet('prevent-navigation', 'go.greentrafsa.com')
x1337x.eu#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open', 'x1337x.eu')
```

Note: this temporary fix only works if the Redirect website (greentrafsa) remains unchanged.

The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

The reporter's target on fazier.com is the "Sponsors" card at the top of the homepage, a directly sold, server-rendered sponsor placement served entirely first-party (its data is in the page's own props, its images come from the site's own S3 bucket, and its link goes straight to the sponsor). The repository policy excludes the site's own first-party advertising, so no rule is proposed and the issue is recommended for closing.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, Filter policy:⁠ "The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing." Filter policy document (AdGuard filter policy, Ad blocking filters — Limitations and exceptions):⁠ "The site's own advertising should not be deliberately blocked. However, it should not be unblocked if the blocking is caused by general filtering rules." Observed:⁠ the sponsor card is the site's own, directly sold advertising — rendered from the page's own server props (props.pageProps.sponsorAds), creative served from the site's own bucket fazier-production.s3.amazonaws.com, and a direct sponsor link (https:⁠//redleafpeptides.com?ref=fazier); the HAR contains no third-party ad or sponsor network host. The report is not an anti-adblock wall, paywall, or scam/phishing case, so none of the other policy branches applies.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"307cf37afdc077527a1096b5f6d59d383d3737b46fb507746e839f1cc7da1539"} -->
The filter policy leaves this report to a maintainer

## Reproduced symptom

The reported anti-adblock notice could not be reached:⁠ the site serves an empty article body (only the Yandex RTB slot) both with the reporter's filtering settings and with no filtering at all, and no detector script appears in the captured requests. Per the run instruction, a non-German anti-adblock wall may only be fixed once the captured requests show the detector script, so the report goes to a maintainer for a decision.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

Run instruction (Filter policy):⁠ "Any other anti-adblock wall:⁠ write a rule only once the page's requests the agent captured show the detector script; without it, hand the report to a maintainer." The captured requests in the reporter-profile session (artifact:⁠har:⁠72ba1561-8357-4eb6-8c79-0fa31e565a9b, 215 entries) contain no detector script:⁠ only page-owned assets (/nocopy.js, /public/js/dle_js.js, /templates/FlixTV/js/*.js) and third-party ad/tracker hosts already handled by the published lists (Yandex RTB, AdSense, metrika, informer.yandex.ru, aflt.market.yandex.ru, stats.vk-portal.net, top-fwz1.mail.ru). The wall is not German:⁠ рамзи.рф (xn--80aodos.xn--p1ai) is a Russian-language site with a Russian notice, so the German anti-adblock close rule does not apply and the report belongs with a maintainer. No rule can be written from observed evidence:⁠ the reported notice has no locatable element, request or selector in this environment, so any hiding rule or scriptlet would be guessed rather than verified.

## Artifacts

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — Issue #⁠247460 reports a floating cookie consent banner on www⁠.jtexpress.de/tracking (AdGuard for Windows, annoyance). Live evidence in the adguard_cli (AdGuard CLI proxy) environment confirms the reporter's boxed "Cookies" popover, and the domain-scoped hiding rule jtexpress.de#⁠#⁠.cookie-sdk-popover verified:⁠ the dialog disappeared, the page stayed intact and scrollable, and no other instance remained. ## Rule `jtexpress.de##.cookie-sdk-popover` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie consent overlay (annoyance), not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not a German anti-adblock wall or popup (the page shows no ad-blocker detection message), so no run-instruction rule closes it or hands it to a maintainer. The AdGuard Cookie Notices filter exists for exactly this class of element, and the banner is rendered by the site's own bundled cookie SDK with no third-party CMP request to block, so a per-site cosmetic rule is the accepted fix. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/5dbf4704f00407300bdda383957953f518f31098/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Issue #⁠247471 reports that the tracking collector host collector.netuno-ve.i.mtvreg.com is missing from the official AdGuard DNS list; the reporter's DNS log shows it blocked only by their own user rule. The locked network-filtering environment came back capability-limited (www⁠.netunogo.net did not answer through the AdGuard CLI proxy, so HTTPS filtering was unproven and every browser/validation tool refused), so the exact domain rule is carried for human review in SpywareFilter/sections/tracking_servers.txt instead of being verified.

## Candidate for review

`||collector.netuno-ve.i.mtvreg.com^`

SpywareFilter/sections/tracking_servers.txt

Not verified: Environment limit:⁠ the locked adguard_cli environment was capability_limited (environment_preparation_failed / https_filtering_unproven — www⁠.netunogo.net did not answer through the AdGuard CLI proxy, proxy_connect_failed), so launch_browser and apply_rule refused with gate environment-pending. I could therefore neither observe the collector request from the site nor run any before/after phase to confirm the rule blocks it, and no visual review exists. A human should also confirm the block does not disrupt NetUno Go playback or sign-in, which the filter policy requires for tracking rules and which the reporter's own statement is the only, unverified, source for.

## Missing information

- No route or placement file for AdGuard DNS (DNS-resolver) reports in this repository/instruction: The run instruction routes only browser-extension and CLI-proxy (desktop/mobile app) website-filtering reports; the reported product here is AdGuard DNS (private DNS server, DNS-over-TLS, OpenWrt router), which filters at DNS resolution. The accepted adguard_cli environment exposed filterBaseline filterId 15 "AdGuard DNS filter" as the official list, but this repository's own structure served by lookup_rule_guidance (CONTRIBUTING "Repository structure") lists only Base, Mobile, Tracking Protection (SpywareFilter), URL Tracking, Social, Annoyances, Experimental, unblocking-search-ads, language filters and Quick Fixes — no AdGuard DNS filter folder. So there is no stated file in which a rule for an AdGuard-DNS-labelled tracker report belongs; I had to infer the closest file of the same rule kind (SpywareFilter/sections/tracking_servers.txt).
